input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the opening sentence, make the uncertainty more concrete: “人们不知道什么植物能吃，什么植物不能吃。”
2. At the point where people eat harmful plants, add a clear consequence: “很多人吃了有毒的植物以后，常常生病。”
3. When introducing Shennong, add his purpose to make him sound determined: “有一个叫神农的老人决定找出哪些植物可以做药。”

ideas.reason: This repeats what the learner already says in the opening sentence.
It gives a concrete, story-appropriate result of eating poisonous plants.
The learner already says that Shennong wants to solve this problem.
